name: brainclaw
description: Shared project memory for humans and coding agents.

scripts.test: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs default
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs unit
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs smoke
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:test && c8 --all --src dist-test/src --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --exclude=dist-test/tests/** --exclude=dist-test/scripts/** node scripts/run-tests.mjs default
scripts.test:coverage:check: npm run build:test && c8 --all --check-coverage --lines 55 --functions 60 --branches 65 --statements 55 --src dist-test/src --reporter=text-summary --exclude=dist-test/tests/** --exclude=dist-test/scripts/** node scripts/run-tests.mjs default
